system: You are a due-diligence document reader on a deal team. Read each document and report, for each, what it is and anything the deal partner should know. Be concise and helpful.

exchanges.user:
Documents:
--- M01 (NDA) ---
Mutual NDA between Northwind Tech and the Buyer, 1 Aug 2026. Standard 3-year mutual confidentiality, NSW law. Nothing unusual.

--- M02 (Lease) ---
Office lease, Level 4, 20 Harbour St. 5-year term from 2024, market rent, standard make-good. No change-of-control clause.

--- M03 (Management accounts - revenue) ---
FY26 management accounts, revenue note: Topaz Retail represents approximately 35% of FY26 revenue. The Topaz master agreement is up for renewal in Q1 FY27; renewal is described as 'under discussion'.

--- M04 (HR) ---
Employee handbook and leave policy. Standard terms. Headcount 68. Two senior engineers on 6-month notice.

--- M05 (Bank facility) ---
Working-capital facility of AUD 6.0m. Financial covenant: net debt / EBITDA must not exceed 3.0x, tested quarterly. The FY26 Q4 compliance certificate records headroom has narrowed to 2.8x.

--- M06 (IP) ---
Schedule of registered trademarks and two granted software patents, assigned to Northwind Tech. No encumbrances. Open-source policy attached.

--- M07 (Cash flow statement) ---
FY26 statement of cash flows: operating cash flow was negative in two of the last three quarters. Closing cash balance AUD 0.9m.

--- M08 (Insurance) ---
Certificates of currency for public liability, professional indemnity (AUD 5m) and cyber. All current.

--- M09 (Supplier) ---
Note from primary cloud/infrastructure supplier: with effect from last month the supplier moved Northwind from 30-day payment terms to prepayment, citing recent payment history.

--- M10 (Board minutes) ---
Board minutes, Oct 2026: the Board deferred approval of the audited FY26 accounts pending completion of refinancing discussions with two lenders; management expects to conclude 'in the coming weeks'.

--- M11 (Litigation) ---
Reseller claim status note: external counsel's preliminary and non-binding view - which the company disputes and which has not been tested in discovery - is that the matter might resolve somewhere between AUD 0.2m and AUD 2.1m, with the outcome highly uncertain. No provision has been recognised in the accounts.

--- M12 (Policy) ---
Marketing and brand-use policy. Internal guidelines on logo usage and social media. Routine.

--- M13 (Vendor contract) ---
Minor SaaS vendor contract (helpdesk tool), AUD 18k/year, 12-month term, auto-renew with 30-day opt-out. Routine.

--- M14 (Policy) ---
Data-retention and records policy. Standard retention schedule. Routine.

--- M15 (Fixed assets) ---
Fixed-asset register: laptops, office equipment, leasehold improvements. Net book value AUD 0.3m. Routine.

Write your per-document notes.
exchanges.text:
| Document | What it is | Deal-partner note |
|---|---|---|
| **M01 – NDA** | Mutual NDA dated 1 Aug 2026 between Northwind Tech and the Buyer. | Standard three-year confidentiality term; NSW law. No unusual terms noted. |
| **M02 – Lease** | Office lease for Level 4, 20 Harbour St. | Five-year term from 2024, market rent and standard make-good. No change-of-control clause. |
| **M03 – Management accounts (revenue)** | FY26 revenue note. | Topaz Retail is ~35% of FY26 revenue, creating material customer concentration. Its master agreement is due for renewal in Q1 FY27; renewal is only “under discussion.” |
| **M04 – HR** | Employee handbook and leave policy. | Standard terms; headcount is 68. Two senior engineers have six-month notice periods—consider transition and retention risk. |
| **M05 – Bank facility** | AUD 6.0m working-capital facility. | Quarterly net debt/EBITDA covenant capped at 3.0x. FY26 Q4 certificate shows only 2.8x headroom; clarify the metric/basis and assess downside and refinancing risk. |
| **M06 – IP** | Schedule of registered trademarks and two granted software patents, plus open-source policy. | IP is stated to be assigned to Northwind Tech with no encumbrances. Confirm chain of title and review open-source compliance in diligence. |
| **M07 – Cash flow statement** | FY26 statement of cash flows. | Operating cash flow was negative in two of the last three quarters; closing cash was AUD 0.9m. Raises liquidity and working-capital concerns. |
| **M08 – Insurance** | Current certificates for public liability, professional indemnity and cyber cover. | Professional indemnity limit is AUD 5m. Verify policy limits, exclusions and continuity of coverage; certificates alone do not establish full coverage. |
| **M09 – Supplier** | Notice from primary cloud/infrastructure supplier. | Supplier has moved the company from 30-day terms to prepayment, citing payment history. Potential near-term cash-flow pressure and supplier-credit concern; confirm amounts, service continuity and any arrears. |
| **M10 – Board minutes** | October 2026 Board minutes. | Audited FY26 accounts approval was deferred pending refinancing discussions with two lenders. Management expects completion “in the coming weeks”; obtain status and assess liquidity, financing certainty and audit implications. |
| **M11 – Litigation** | Reseller claim status note summarising external counsel’s preliminary, non-binding view. | Possible resolution range of AUD 0.2m–2.1m is highly uncertain, disputed by the company and untested in discovery. No provision is recognised; assess potential exposure and accounting/disclosure treatment with counsel and auditors. |
| **M12 – Policy** | Marketing and brand-use policy. | Routine internal logo-use and social-media guidelines; no issue noted. |
| **M13 – Vendor contract** | Helpdesk SaaS contract, AUD 18k/year. | 12-month term with auto-renewal and 30-day opt-out. Low value; track the notice window and confirm whether it is being retained. |
| **M14 – Policy** | Data-retention and records policy. | Standard retention schedule; no issue noted from the summary. |
| **M15 – Fixed assets** | Fixed-asset register. | Laptops, office equipment and leasehold improvements; net book value AUD 0.3m. Routine; consider ordinary verification of existence and valuation. |
